notes: belongs_to_language_group is transitive (RELATIONS.md). Families are disjoint: a firm GCI makes membership in Indo-European and in Uralic incompatible, so the edit takes Hungarian out of Uralic (via its old branch) and the old answer 'no' for Balto-Slavic follows. 'Magyar' is another name for Hungarian (a background equality, so Magyar is left out of distinct). related_far is encoded as membership of Uralic (the family Hungarian shared with Finnish). q1 (the proto-language of a branch) has no relation in RELATIONS.md.
